methods.stress: Completed months; at least 10 and 80% active market dates; at least 6 eligible months/year/bucket. Bottom ceil(20% of months) by monthly median of daily cross-sectional ADV20 medians. Compare with remaining months within the same year.
methods.cohorts: Freeze eligible size-bucket membership at each completed month-end. Require full next-20-source-session horizon; classify final membership, continuous usability in any group, and same-bucket continuity without replacing missing or ineligible rows. Frozen-cohort minimum observed median/baseline requires >=90% eligible coverage on every future session.
methods.minutes: First/middle/last previously audited qualifying date per year, not random. SH/SZ eligible feature rows; unique same-date bars; >=240 recorded bars; positive turnover; minute sum within 1% of daily amount*1000. Window shares pool security-days; absent window records stay missing. Timestamp endpoints are recorded-clock filters, not verified bar-interval semantics.
methods.denominator: Full observed minute turnover, including any auction bars. Windows overlap; shares must not be summed.
